text:
maya: Deploy finished for service-infer at 11:02 PST. Ben pushed canary (tag: v2.1.3-canary). Please run quick smoke checks and signal when green.
deploy-bot: Deployment event: service-infer v2.1.3-canary -> canary pool. Status: COMPLETED.
ben: I'm on it. running the standard checklist now (health, auth, smoke-gen, metrics).
camille: I'll watch latency dashboards and error rate on /models/* routes.
liam: I'll do a quick embed/vec sanity: generate embedding for sample payload and check similarity score distribution.
maya: Quick checklist (copy):
- curl health endpoint (auth token)
- sanity prompt generation: short & long sequences
- kv-cache warm check (ensure cold-start lat < 200ms for 8 tokens)
- tail logs for 5m for ERROR or WARN spikes
- metrics: p95 latency, 5xx count, tokens/sec
- rollback readiness: verify rollback tag exists and slots free

ben: health OK:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://redwood.example.com/service-infer/health
# returns {"status":"ok","uptime":"2m"}
```
ben: quick gen tests: short prompt -> looks good; long prompt (2k tokens) returns and stream resumes correctly. initial token latencies slightly higher on canary (~30ms p50 bump) but p95 within SLO.
camille: watching dashboards: spike in p50 for a minute on model-route-3 at 11:04, p95 stable. error rate 5xx = 0.01% over last 5m.
liam: embeddings check: sample vector dims 1536, similarity baseline fine. tokens/sec steady.
ops: noticed routing config change in canary: fallback timeout set to 1500ms (was 1000ms). could explain minor p50 bump.
ben: thanks — reverting fallback timeout to 1000ms for canary, applying now.
ben: applied revert, restarting router.
deploy-bot: Config update applied by ben at 11:06.
camille: latency back to expected baseline, p50 diff gone. no new errors. :white_check_mark:
maya: KV cache warm: observing warm hits increment across nodes, cold-start latencies under 180ms for sampled requests.
ben: Rollback readiness: tag v2.1.2 exists and slot for fast rollback is free on dedicated pool.
liam: leaving a note in the release ticket for the timeout tweak + rationale.
maya: OK — marking canary as healthy. I'll promote to gradual rollout at 11:15 if no regressions in next 10m. ping here if anything odd. :thumbsup:
